title: A Cargo Expander II into an empty utility slot of a trader docked at the War Citadel (Krynn), bought there
note: Written by Mercury, 2026-11-24 07:28 UTC (orders ENT-085 block MERCURY: close the <80% alarms, F40; rule F17: T2+ modules in parallel batches). The scorecard's module alarm for Trade: 390 empty slots, 0.3% fitted (hive.py briefing 07:01 UTC); our 85 traders carry 3 modules in all (table ship_modules 07:27 UTC). The War Citadel asks 1,421 x 26 for cargo_expander_ii (table books 07:26 UTC), where 42 traders stand docked: no fuel to fit. One per ship, 26 ships at most (the ask's depth), about 37,000 cr in all; requires.ask closes it when the ask is gone. The form of fit-cargo-expander-factory-belt (33 runs). The next batch, Cargo Expander I at the Grand Exchange (500 x 895) or Confederacy Central Command (292 x 494), waits for this one's first runs.
